headword: {芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}
reading: げいじゅつかんしょう
gloss: art appreciation; appreciation of the arts

definitions.gloss: art appreciation; appreciation of the arts
definitions.explanation: The act of viewing, enjoying, and understanding works of art, including visual art, music, theater, and other artistic forms.

examples.japanese: {芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧です。
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an art appreciation class at school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like spending my days off appreciating art at museums.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧ (art, the arts) and ⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧ (appreciation, viewing). Used for all forms of art — visual arts, music, theater, film, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: art appreciation time
- {芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧: art appreciation class
- {芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧: art appreciation event

RELATED WORDS:
- {音楽鑑賞|おんがくかんしょう}: music appreciation
- {映画鑑賞|えいがかんしょう}: film appreciation / watching movies
- ⟦{観賞|かんしょう}→観賞：14195_kanshou⟧: appreciation (for natural beauty, flowers, fish) — note the different kanji from ⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧

WRITING:
⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧ (with {鑑|かん}) is used for art and cultural works, while ⟦{観賞|かんしょう}→観賞：14195_kanshou⟧ (with {観|かん}) is used for natural beauty like flowers and fish. This is a common source of confusion.
